articleTitle: BAGNet: Bidirectional Aware Guidance Network for Malignant Breast lesions Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Breast lesions segmentation is an important step of computer-aided diagnosis system, and it has attracted much attention. However, accurate segmentation of malignant breast lesions is a challenging task due to the effects of heterogeneous structure and similar intensity distributions. In this paper, a novel bidirectional aware guidance network (BAGNet) is proposed to segment the malignant lesion from breast ultrasound images. Specifically, the bidirectional aware guidance network is used to capture the context between global (low-level) and local (high-level) features from the input coarse saliency map. The introduction of the global feature map can reduce the interference of surrounding tissue (background) on the lesion regions. To evaluate the segmentation performance of the network, we compared with several state-of-the-art medical image segmentation methods on the public breast ultrasound dataset using six commonly used evaluation metrics. Extensive experimental results indicate that our method achieves the most competitive segmentation results on malignant breast ultrasound images.

articleTitle: YOLO Based Bridge Surface Defect Detection Using Decoupled Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Bridge surface defect detection is an essential method for evaluating the bridge quality and subsequent repair. Convolutional neural network based intelligent object detectors have been powerful for defect detection in recent years. In this paper, we propose a model based on the YOLO detector for detection. We use the convolutional block attention module, decoupled prediction head, and focal loss function to improve performance. To verify our proposed model, we perform experiments on an open bridge surface defect dataset, and our model can obtain 90.3% mAP50 and 72.8% mAP75. The detection precision of our network is higher than the original YOLOv5.

articleTitle: Estimation of Vehicle Sideslip Angle based on Modified Sliding Mode Observer and Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: It is well known that the knowledge of dynamic states is crucial for electronic stability control (ESC) and active safety system of automotive vehicles. In this paper, a novel method is established for the estimation of side slip angle in the presence of measurement noises and different road frictions. To begin with, a vehicle dynamic model and a tire model are exploited to reveal the relationship between tire road friction coefficient (TRFC) and sideslip angle. Furthermore, in order to eliminate the sensors error in the inertial measurement unit, a recurrent neural network is deployed by modeling the lateral motion and sensors measurement. Unlike conventional methods, a modified Sliding Mode Observer (MSMO) is proposed to manage the uncertainty brought by road conditions. Finally, the presented method is validated by co-simulations of Carsim and Matlab. The results show that the developed approach is robust to the abnormal measurement noise and different road friction coefficients.

articleTitle: Path Tracking Control Algorithm Considering Delay Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: The delay in the control loop of autonomous vehicles can diminish controller effectiveness to a great extent and may even engender instability in a critical driving situation. Aiming at the path tracking problem with delays in the control loop, this paper presents a model predictive control method that considers the delay compensation. Firstly, the nonlinear vehicle dynamics model with delay is converted into a linear time-varying delay-free discrete system by expanding the steering delay command into the state variables of the system, and then the model is used as the predictive model of the model predictive control to design the controller. Finally, the proposed control system is evaluated by both co-simulation of MATLAB/Simulink & CarSim. Compared with the traditional model predictive control algorithm, the control compensation strategy based on the model predictive control algorithm proposed in this paper can significantly improve the robustness and stability of the system.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Large-Scale Space Mocap System Suitable for Intelligent Cluster Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: In this paper, we first offer some brief introduction of our existed Large-Scale Space Mocap System which supports identification and tracking in a workshop level larger-scale space with sub-millimeter level distance accuracy and millisecond level time delay. Then to overcome the existing problems of traditional spatial-shape-based recognition scheme, we extend it to a time-series-based recognition scheme, and yield a Global Time Synchronization Mocap System (GTSMS), which is more suitable for the on-line research and development of intelligent cluster robots with dozens or hundreds of individuals in large-scale space. Firstly, a global time synchronization method is developed to ensure a sub-microsecond time synchronization precision between the master Mocap Camera and the Sync Station, as well as a sub-millisecond time synchronization precision between the Sync Station and all Sync Tags. Then, a strobe IRLEDs’ encoding method is employed to encode all the IRLEDs into suitable values, and ensure stable identity recognition and tracking of each individual marker and rigid body tag during use. On that basis, a standardized tag assembly method is proposed for more flexible, more standardized and larger-scale space’s applications. Moreover, an on-line management/ configuration method is utilized to add more standardization, convenience and intelligence to our new system. Finally, we provide real demonstration of the real-time recognition and tracking effect of some UAV agents in large-scale space of 600m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> area and 4m height, which fully verifies the stability, high precision, intelligence, standardization and convenience of our new intelligent Large-Scale Space Mocap System, i.e., GTSMS.

articleTitle: Dynamic Obstacle Detection and Environmental Modelling for Agricultural Drones
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Drones used in precision agricultural applications are required to fly at low altitudes where a multitude of static and dynamic obstacles are present. Real-time perception and obstacle detection are crucial to achieve collision avoidance accurately and speedily in a cluttered and dynamic environment with multiple static and moving obstacles. This paper presents a real-time obstacle detection and environmental modelling method for agricultural drones in the presence of multiple static and dynamic obstacles. A simulation experimental test bed was setup and the results of the evaluation experiments verified the capability of the proposed ellipsoidal bounding box approximation-based method for representing the environment properly with a significant reduction in volume for real-world obstacles in comparison to existing benchmark spherical bounding box approximation. Furthermore, the proposed ellipsoidal bounding box approximation method continues to perform better over benchmark spherical bounding box approximation when point clouds keep getting larger as the industry develops perception sensors of higher quality and performance.

articleTitle: Run-and-jump Planning and Control of a Compact Two-wheeled Legged Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: With high energy efficiency and strong terrain adaptability, the two-wheeled legged robot combines the advantages of legged robots and wheeled robots. The compact mechanism enables the robot to run and jump only with four motors. However, the robot’s underactuation and instability make it difficult to achieve simultaneous run-and-jump motion. In order to solve this problem, a motion planning and control scheme is proposed. First, the dynamic model of the compact two-wheeled legged robot is established. Subsequently, the run-and-jump trajectory is planned by using nonlinear programming. In order to accurately execute the planned trajectories, two controllers are respectively designed for the jumping motion and running motion. Specifically, an impedance tracking controller is designed to achieve smooth and compliant jumping behavior under different practical conditions. On the other hand, an LQR (Linear Quadratic Regulator) controller is constructed to realize the stable running motion. The overall planning and control scheme is validated in Simscape. With the peak torque of 35 Nm for the hip motor, the run-and-jump motion can reach 20 cm jump height and 40 cm horizontal distance.

articleTitle: Multimodal Based Automatic Feeding Robotic Device
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: The automatic feeding robot is designed to solve the problem of self-feeding for the disabled and has a wide range of application prospects in the fields of medical care and social elderly care. However, most of the existing feeding robotic devices are limited with fixed operation and cannot fully address the various needs of the disabled. The systems usually can only complete tasks within preset procedures and lack of the interaction process with the disabled. In this paper, we develop a multimodal based automatic feeding robotic device. It consists of a speech recognition module, a visual perception module, and a interaction control module. The speech recognition module provides an entrance for users to interact with robots. Users can make their own decisions about the order and speed of eating through speech interaction. The visual perception module utilizes the received RGBD images to detect food and faces, and localize them in the real world. The final interaction control module is to control the robot to deliver food to the human mouth. We evaluate each module separately, they all reach the level of daily use. And then we conduct human feeding experiments in a real robotic device. In 30 attempts, the feeding success rate reached 83.3%.

articleTitle: A New Benchmark Dataset for Egyptian License Plate Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Automatic license plate detection and recognition have become an integral part of the new ecosystems to ensure safety and traffic management. It is also challenging because it depends on several factors, including the country’s design, colors, language, and texture. One of the main issues that face the deep learning models is the lack of resources and datasets, especially in the Arabic language. In this work, we propose a large-scale dataset, namely Egyptian Automatic License Plate Recognition (EALPR), to address this issue. The images are collected from social-media websites using scraping tools. After cleaning and sanity checks, the YOLO detector is used for annotation. The total number of vehicles is 2,450, including different locations, times (night and day), and backgrounds to guarantee the balance of the dataset. We also provide the detailed steps of the dataset collection and annotation. Finally, we discuss the comparison of the state-of-the-art open-source datasets. The dataset and models will be publicly available on https://github.com/ahmedramadan96/EALPR

Author Keywords: automatic license plate detection and recognition

articleTitle: Dynamic Charging Scheduling Optimization for Electric Vehicles Based on Quantum SWARM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: A dynamic scheduling method based on Quantum SWARM is proposed for electric vehicles charging in the relative disordered traffic environment. It aims to maximum the overall charging efficiency considering the realistic individual competition and group collaboration. The result of the simulation validation shows that for 100 random target power-anxiety clients, Quantum SWARM algorithm could iterate in 1 step with reduction of error comparison around 87%, which could provide a guaranteed optimal allocation planing for charging station, and a derived control logic for swarm intelligent agents such as autonomous electric vehicles.

articleTitle: A Nonlinear Disturbance Observer Based on Sliding Mode Control for a Lower Limber Exoskeleton Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: During the process of human-robot cooperative motion, the internal frictions and modeling errors existing in the system may significantly deteriorate the control precision of a lower limb exoskeleton. To compensate the uncertainty during the human-robot cooperative motion, a nonlinear disturbance observer based sliding mode control strategy is designed in this paper. Firstly, the dynamic model of a lower limb exoskeleton is established. Secondly, low-pass filter and nonlinear disturbance observer are designed to observe the uncertain disturbance and modeling errors. Then, a high-order sliding mode controller is designed to ensure the control precision of the human-robot interaction system. Finally, the effectiveness and reliability of the designed control method are verified with the joint simulation between MATLAB and ADAMS.

articleTitle: Autonomous Flight Control Design Based on Multi-Sensor Fusion for a Low-Cost Quadrotor in GPS-Denied Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: This paper presents a fully autonomous and low-cost quadrotor helicopter system in GPS-denied environments. An extended Kalman filter (EKF) framework is employed to fuse the raw data from inertial measurement unit (IMU), optical flow, ultrasonic rangefinder to achieve real-time state estimation of the quadrotor. An improved cascaded proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control scheme is proposed to achieve high-precision flight control for the quadrotor. A lightweight, powerful app of DroneKit-Python is integrated to directly guide the flight mission of the quadrotor on an onboard computer. The onboard computer which communicates with the flight controller using the MAVLink protocol augments the performance of the autopilot by a low-latency link. Finally, the autonomous quadrotor system is justified by real-world experiments, and the experimental results show that the quadrotor can realize high-precision autonomous localization in an indoor environment.

articleTitle: Renal Ultrasound Image Segmentation Based on U-Net and Generative Adversarial Nets
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Ultrasound images are quite useful for doctors to diagnose the kidney diseases nowadays. Since the U-Net network was proposed, it has been applied in the field of ultrasonic image segmentation. We propose a method that combine the U-Net with the generic advantageous networks, creating a more efficient approach of the segmentation of renal ultrasound images. By introducing GAN's supervision mechanism, the segmented network has a better performance. We constructed a training set of 200 renal ultrasound images and a test set composed of 40 images, and carried out experiments on them. Experiments show that compared with the traditional U-Net, the method proposed in this paper improves the accuracy on the same test set. The accuracy of our network reaches 97.83%, which is higher than 97.00% of U-Net.

articleTitle: Optimal Design for the Torsional Elastic Element Topology of a Rotary Series Elastic Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: The series elastic actuator improves the compliance of exoskeleton by introducing a elastic element and ensures its safe interaction ability. Therefore, it is regarded as a new driving mechanism by scholars. Suitable elastic element is conducive to realize the miniaturization and lightweight of SEA, but its topology design is complex and lack of guidance. Based on the finite element simulation environment and three-dimensional parametric CAD environment, this paper analyzes the influence of different size parameters and topology on the pressure of the elastic element, summarizes the characteristics of three topology structures, and puts forward the optimal design method of a torsional elastic element topology. Through the research, we can conclude that the compression effect of elastic beam with specific shape is better than that of curved elastic beam, and the width of elastic beam has a great influence on the torsional elastic element.

articleTitle: Research on the Simulation Test Method of Autonomous Driving Vehicle Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: A study of autonomous driving simulation under car-following traffic flow was carried out in this paper based on AD Chauffeur simulation cloud platform developed by CATARC. Based on the platform interface, a perception recognition algorithm under the framework of ”YOLO v5 +Deep Sort+ triangular perspective estimation”, a decision algorithm based on finite state machine and a control algorithm based on pure tracking were designed, verified and updated by the cloud platform. The experimental results show that the updated autonomous algorithm based on monocular vision can satisfy the driving demand under car-following traffic flow. With the help of the cloud platform, the development cycle of autonomous driving algorithm can be shortened, and the adaptability among perception, decision-making and control algorithms can be also improved, which is an effective and convenient autonomous driving simulation method.

articleTitle: Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning based Mobile Manipulation Control for Dynamic Object Tracking and Grasping
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Agile control of mobile manipulator is challenging because of the high complexity coupled by the robotic system and the unstructured working environment. Tracking and grasping a dynamic object with a random trajectory is even harder. In this paper, a multi-task reinforcement learning-based mobile manipulation control framework is proposed to achieve general dynamic object tracking and grasping. Several basic types of dynamic trajectories are chosen as the training set for the task. To improve policy generalization in practice, random noise and dynamics randomization are introduced during the training process. Extensive experiments show that our trained policy can adapt to unseen random dynamic trajectories with about 0.1 m tracking error and 75% grasping success rate for dynamic objects. The trained policy can also be successfully deployed on a real mobile manipulator.

articleTitle: Application Research of Belt Conveyor Monitoring Based on Laser Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: To realize mine intelligent management and improve coal mine production efficiency and production safety, aiming at the existing coal flow volume calculation method of belt conveyor, a coal flow volume detection algorithm divided by the linear model is proposed. Using the direct laser triangulation method, the visual measurement experimental platform of coal passing amount of belt conveyor is built, the software and hardware design of the measurement system is completed, the image processing algorithm and processing workflow are optimized, and the laser coal passing amount monitoring prototype is developed. The experiment shows that by detecting the edge of coal flow in real-time and registering the point cloud according to the edge of coal flow, the overall information of coal flow can be accurately constructed, which makes the volume calculation more accurate.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Tracking Control of Non-holonomic Wheeled Robot Using Backstepping Adaptive PI Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: In this paper, a backstepping adaptive PI controller is proposed to solve the trajectory tracking problem of a nonholonomic wheeled robot with unknown parameters and bounded external interference. Firstly, based on the non-holonomic constrained wheeled mobile robot model, the backstepping controller is designed to obtain the virtual speed control and angular velocity control of the system, which effectively solves the problem of continuous excitation of input in the process of trajectory tracking of the system. Then, a variable-gain PI controller is designed to realize self-adjustment and real-time trajectory tracking in the case of system disturbance. The simulation result is compared with the traditional PID control method, which proves the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Covariance Matrix Evolutionary Preference-based Policy Search for Robot Confrontation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: For robot confrontation task, reward derives only at the end, which makes the optimal policy learning very hard. Conventional deep reinforcement learning such as Deep Deterministic Policy Search (DDPG) performs poorly for sparse reward problems. To deal with this problem, in this paper, a novel approach, namely Covariance Matrix Evolutionary Preferencebased Policy Search (CMA-EPPS) is proposed. Specifically, the robot confrontation task is formulated as a preference-based task firstly. Then an evolutionary preference-based reinforcement learning policy search approach is developed. To improve the searching efficiency, covariance matrix adaptation is introduced, and to improve the optimization, a novel ranking method and a preference judging approach are also integrated. Finally, the proposed method is used in the robot confrontation environment and results show that CMA-EPPS can outperform the conventional methods such as DDPG.

articleTitle: Multi-robot Cooperation Learning Based on Univariate Search Technique and Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Directly applying the method of single-agent re-inforcement learning(SARL) to multi-agent tasks is difficult, because it is often hard to achieve good cooperation results. In this paper, a novel training framework(called Uni-DDPG) based on Univariate Search Technique and Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient(DDPG) is proposed which can learn the cooperation between two agents. Specifically, the policy of one agent is fixed, and DDPG is used to learn the policy of the other agent, then the learned policy is fixed and the previously fixed policy is optimized with DDPG, so on and so on. In addition, in order to improve the robustness and efficiency of learning, Win-or-Learn-Fast method is adopted to update parameters. Finally, a two-robot cooperation task is built and the proposed method is utilized to learn the optimal policies. Results show that the two robots can learn cooperation with the proposed method which outperforms independent DDPG largely.

articleTitle: Design of Ultrasonic Distance Measuring System for Auto Palletizer in Earthquake Rescue Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: In order to ensure the safe use of smart devices such as auto palletizer, unmanned navigation robot, self-operated robot, etc. in modern warehouse, automatic obstacle avoidance and navigation technology have been widely used to measure the spacing between equipment, equipment and warehouse facilities or other obstacles. A design scheme of ultrasonic ranging system based on Tiva C series single chip microcomputer is proposed. Since the frequency of Tiva C series MCU is as high as 80 to 120 MHz, the capacity of time measurement will be enhanced which will improve the measurement accuracy. When the timer is started, the PWM channel is started to drive the ultrasonic transmitter and the capture channel will capture the echo signal. The ultrasonic velocity is adjusted real-time according to the actual environmental temperature. With the system, distance between stacker and the obstacle were calculated in order to determine following motion of the stacker, such as keeping moving or making a sound-light alarm or decelerating to stop, with the pre-design threshold value of distance. Through abundant tests, the system illustrated that it achieved predetermined function, the alarm and stop distance meet the requirements and could be used in the actual environment.

articleTitle: Research on Force Tracking in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: In the era of the Humachine, the environment robots face is often complex and time-varying, therefore, the research on time-varying force tracking of robots in time-varying environment has very important practical significance. Aiming at the problem that the reference trajectory designed by Seraji H is only applicable to the fixed environment stiffness, the Lyapunov method is used in this paper to give the sufficient proof of the asymptotic stability of the time-varying force tracking error in the time-varying environment. In addition, because the indirect adaptive method cannot solve the force tracking problem in the time-varying environment, this paper uses the force tracking error signal to design a PID compensator with variable arguments to compensate the inaccuracy of the reference trajectory obtained by the original method. Finally, simulation results show that the proposed method has good force tracking performance intime-varying environment.

articleTitle: The Realization of Electronic Cylinder Control of Hydraulic Brake Test Bench Based on CANopen Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complex structure, poor commonality and low repeatability of the existing hydraulic brake test bench, the servo electric cylinder control based on CANopen communication is proposed to replace the foot pedal. The object dictionary of CANopen communication sub-protocol DS301 and driver sub-protocol DS402 and the format of CANopen communication message are analyzed, and the transformation relation between each state of servo driver and the setting of PDO mapping message under three modes of position, speed and torque are described in detail. DSPACE cabinet, servo driver and electric cylinder assembly are used to form the test platform, and the servo electric cylinder communication mapping based on CANopen communication and closed-loop control in three modes of position, speed and torque are realized on the upper computer through Matlab/Simulink. The test results show that using CANopen communication to realize the servo electric cylinder control response fast, high repeatability, high precision, simple and easy to operate, by associating the brake pedal opening signal with the vehicle model, users can well achieve a variety of complex working conditions of the bench test.

articleTitle: A Helmet Detection Model Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of missed detection and false detection in existing helmet detection models in complex construction environment, a cross feature pyramid helmet detection model CPAHelmet based on attention mechanism is proposed. The skip connection and CBAM attention mechanism are introduced into PANet, and a cross feature pyramid network is constructed, which strengthens the feature expression of shallow location information and deep semantic information, and improves the detection ability of the network for small-sized helmet objects. CIOU is used instead of IOU to optimize the position regression process of the detection boxes, which reduces the training difficulty of the network and improves the convergence ability of the model. Ablation experiments show that the model achieves the best performance in the helmet detection scenario. Compared with models such as YOLOv3, RFBNet, SSD, and Faster RCNN, the indicator of mAP is improved by 0.72, 4.73, 22.54, and 24.28, respectively. Furthermore, the proposed model achieves the highest detection speed, reaches 21.7FPS, and realizes real-time high-precision detection of helmet objects.

articleTitle: Visual Detection for Non-Ferrous Metal Ingots With Wavelet Denoising and Contour Corner Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: To realize the intelligent grinding of non-ferrous metal ingots, visual detection algorithms are required to provide the information of metal ingots for robotic manipulators. However, metal ingots in moving molds on ingot casting lines are accompanied by complicated backgrounds and continuous changes, which demands higher accuracy and stronger robustness of visual detection. Based on two kinds of metal ingots and the analysis of metal ingot images, a wavelet-based method with an improved threshold and threshold function is utilized to reduce noises. Afterward, the edge information of metal ingots is obtained by edge line segment detection, and the detected edges are selected according to their positions and lengths. Moreover, in order to extract the contour corners of metal ingots, basic contours are detected and further fitted into metal ingot contours. Finally, experimental results verify that the proposed metal ingot detection algorithm achieves satisfactory accuracy, robustness, and real-time performance for different images and metal ingots.

articleTitle: Manipulation Using a Snake Robot Based on the Head Raising Motion
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: The snake robot is a biologically inspired robot with hyper-redundant joints. Though the locomotion control of the robot has been widely studied for decades, there are few works about the manipulation, which is more and more important. In this paper, a two-stage manipulation method is proposed by planning head raising locomotion and controlling the head pose of the snake robot. Specifically, the whole robot is divided into the ground part and the manipulation part, where the ground part is considered as the support polygon to maintain the stability during the head raising motion, and the manipulation part is considered as the manipulator to achieve tasks. The head raising motion planning is solved by nonlinear optimization and the head pose controller is designed by inverse kinematics. Finally the proposed method is verified through simulation. Results show that the head of the snake robot can reach any desired valid pose accurately.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Control System for Underground Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Coal resources play an important role in China's energy structure. Using coal mine inspection robot to replace the traditional manual inspection operation has important application value for realizing coal mine intelligent production. Most of the existing control systems of coal mine inspection robot are bare metal program control, and few real-time operating systems with better real-time and stability are applied. In order to improve the performance of the inspection robot control system, a coal mine inspection robot control system based on QT and RT-Thread and the host computer of human-computer interaction interface are designed, which improves the real-time performance of the inspection robot and the ability to deal with concurrent tasks. The experimental results show that the control system is stable and reliable, and has good cross platform characteristics.

articleTitle: Height Localization of Micropipette in Zebrafish Embryo Penetration Based on Force Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: As an important step of biological micromanipulation, it is extremely complicated to penetrate the cell at a fixed point after the injection micropipette is in contact with the cell. It is hard to reach the same contact point, especially the height position, by only using computer vision in manual operations. There is also a problem of poor repeatability in practice. In this paper, we proposed a contact height localization method of the micropipette for cell penetration based on force sensor, in which the precise contact time was detected by force sensor to obtain the current horizontal position of the micropipette tip, and then the height of the micropipette tip can be calculated based on image processing, improving the efficiency and accuracy of cell penetration. The system is built based on computer vision, force sensor, and computer control. Experiments performed on zebrafish embryos verify the feasibility of the system and the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality-Based 4D-BIM Method for Substations
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: A 4D-BIM visualization technology based on virtual reality is proposed in this paper. Different from the idea of traditional BIM technology, it can make users immerse in the virtual space and carry out construction optimization design very intuitively. Specifically, firstly, the building model information and time information are integrated to form the 4D-BIM technology. The overall substation planning and single object planning can be viewed by dragging the slider. Second, an idea of integrating virtual reality technology into 4D-BIM is put forward, which can immerse users in the Virtual Substation space and improve project perception through visual, auditory, tactile and other senses. Finally, the necessity and feasibility of the proposed scheme in the application of substation construction are verified in the experiment.

articleTitle: Autonomous Underwater Robotic Grasping Research Based on Navigation and Hierarchical Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: This paper proposes a new framework for the autonomous underwater operation of underwater vehicle manipulator systems (UVMS), which is modular, standardized, and hierarchical. The framework consists of three subsystems: perception, navigation, and grasping. The perception module is based on an underwater stereo vision system, which provides effective environment and target information for the navigation and grasping modules. The navigation module is based on ORBSLAM and acoustic odometry, which generates the global map and plans a trajectory for the first initial stage. The grasping module generates the target grasping pose based on the extracted point cloud and the current robot state, and then executes the grasping task based on the motion planner. The proposed system is tested to perform several underwater target grasping tasks in a water tank, demonstrating the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: High Accuracy Detection Strategy for EL Defects in PV Modules Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: A method of intelligent detection and precise localization of EL compositive defects in PV modules based on machine learning has been proposed. In the previous methods, the individual cell is taken as the inspection unit, however, this can not detect the holistic defects in PV modules. In this paper, two series-connected YOLOv5 networks with upstream and downstream process-dependent inspection model is established, which take a PV module as the detecting unit instead of a single cell. It can finish the detection and localization of 13 kinds of defects commonly found currently. These defects include not only those in a single cell, but also holistic defects that may appear after the cell assembling as a module. The experimental results show that both of detecting accuracy and speed are improved effectively for each PV module than before.

articleTitle: A More Effective Way of Target Segmentation of Multispectral Imaging Data Using Kmeans Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Conventional multispectral system are carried in aerial or satellite systems and are limited in temporal resolution and can only measure static targets. In this paper, we design a novel multispectral device that uses a camera array with different filters to continuously and dynamically capture 12-bit images with $960 \times 540$ resolution in 35 bands. Algorithms are also designed to correct for pixel shifts in different channels of images, as well as a method to cluster the captured multispectral images using the K-means algorithm.

articleTitle: The Control Method of Hypersonic Vehicle Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Hypersonic aircraft has nowadays become the research hot button in various countries. However, since the control system of hypersonic aircraft is complicated, many effects such as nonlinear factors, state coupling, aerodynamic parameter changes, etc., and also the flight environment and aerodynamic characteristics change drastically, traditional flight control design methods are not capable anymore. For avoiding the application limitations of existing hypersonic aircraft attitude control methods, this paper proposes a hypersonic aircraft attitude control method based on deep reinforcement learning methods, which provides stably control the aircraft in flight scenarios with uncertain environment and drastic changes in aerodynamic characteristics attitude.

articleTitle: Memory-based Stochastic Trajectory Optimization for Manipulator Obstacle Avoiding Motion Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Obstacle avoidance planning for manipulator is always a challenging research problem especially for manipulator with high degree-of-freedom. The Stochastic Trajectory Optimization for Motion Planning (STOMP) can find solutions efficiently by generating noise trajectories to optimize. However, STOMP’s optimization process starts with an initial trajectory linearly interpolating between the start and the goal configuration, which maybe far away from the optimal trajectory. In addition, STOMP cannot use past knowledge to accelerate the solution of new planning tasks, resulting in more iterations to reach a satisfactory solution. In this paper, We propose a Memory-based STOMP (M-STOMP) algorithm, which stores past trajectories in Memory so that it can generalize the experience obtained from past trajectory optimization to new and similar tasks. Before optimization, a trajectory most relevant to the current situation is matched and that trajectory must be modified in order to reduce the difference between the matched trajectory and the current task. In the optimization process, a more efficient way to generate noise trajectory is used to speed up the convergence process. After optimization, the highly divergent trajectories are stored in memory to maintain diversity and limit memory size. In the simulation experiment, we set up several new planning tasks with different obstacles and goal configurations to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed method can obtain collision-free trajectory with shorter iterations, and the algorithm has more advantages in the new similar planning tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Image Restoration Method of Underwater Robot Based on Dark Channel Prior Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 7th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS)
abstract: Compared with the air imaging environment, the underwater imaging environment is more complicated. Aiming at the problems of color distortion, blurring and low contrast in the images taken in the water, a water based on an improved dark channel prior and color correction is proposed. The following image restoration method. First, a simplified underwater imaging model is constructed based on the dark channel prior algorithm, and then based on the gray world hypothesis theory, color correction is performed on the RGB three channels, and then the adaptive histogram equalization algorithm is used to enhance the contrast and output the restored image. Finally, the algorithm proposed in this paper is applied to the actual scene pictures collected by the underwater robot. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the image contrast and improve the color distortion, and can be applied to the actual application scene of the underwater robot.
